reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: no matter what shampoo i try or use, this is always the base for anything. i double shampoo, and there at least every second time i use this. cleans my scalp VERY clean, and i love the fragrance too. i have itchy scalp sometimes, and i use dry shampoo also, and it calms my scalp a lot. it never dries my hair out even when using it every day. I've been using it since like 3 years now, and i ALWAYS buy it again.
reviews.zh: 無論我試過或者用緊咩洗頭水，呢款都係我嘅基礎。我會雙重洗頭，而且至少每兩次就有一次用呢款。頭皮洗得好乾淨，我都好鍾意佢嘅香味。我有時頭皮會痕，又會用乾洗髮，呢款可以令頭皮舒緩好多。就算每日用，佢都唔會令頭髮乾身。我大約用咗3年，而且我每次都一定會再買。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: Love how this smells! I have short, thin, fine hair in perimenopause and nothing has helped with the hair loss and shedding like this shampoo and conditioner combo! I noticed within the 1st couple of days much less shedding when showering and styling my hair. Also, a little goes a long way, it only takes one pump for my hair, so it lasts a long time!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意佢嘅味道！我正處於圍絕經期，頭髮短、幼、細條，之前冇咩嘢幫到我脫髮同落髮嘅問題，但係呢個洗頭水加護髮素嘅套裝就真係有效！頭兩三日已經見到洗頭同造型嗰陣脫髮少咗好多。另外，只需要少少就夠，我頭髮只係用一泵，所以用得好耐！

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: My hair loves rich products and I've grown over 12 inches in a year, but my scalp started getting really bad buildup from heavier formulas. This shampoo helped so much. My scalp finally feels fresh and properly clean without making my hair feel dry or stripped.
reviews.zh: 我嘅頭髮好啱用濃稠嘅產品，一年內長咗超過12吋，但係用咗較厚重嘅配方之後，頭皮開始有好嚴重嘅積垢。呢款洗頭水幫咗我好多。頭皮終於感覺清新，又洗得好乾淨，而頭髮又唔會覺得乾或者被剝走油分。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: I bought this for my boyfriend’s hair loss. His hair looks amazing and is very shiny. The scent is amazing, very herbal and natural! He started a legitimate hair loss treatment, so it’s hard to speak on the claims that it will help your hair grow. I would assume healthier hair would be a vital factor in growing hair and it has made his hair healthier!
reviews.zh: 我買呢款係為咗我男朋友嘅脫髮問題。佢嘅頭髮好靚，而且好有光澤。味道好正，好草本、好天然！佢開始咗一個正規嘅脫髮療程，所以好難講呢款會唔會令頭髮生長嘅聲稱。我估頭髮健康係生長嘅重要因素，而佢嘅頭髮確實變得健康咗！

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: The scent is pretty strong and very green so not for everyone. It has noticeably thicken my hair but I have noticed more hair fall too?? It also is quite harsh/drying even with using the conditioner. However, it is still a okay clarifying shampoo.
reviews.zh: 味道幾濃，好青草味，唔係人人都啱用。用完令頭髮明顯變厚咗，但係我又覺得脫髮多咗？？即使用咗護髮素，都幾刺激、乾燥。不過，佢都仲算係一款還可以嘅清潔洗頭水。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: Got this for two reasons. I straighten my hair and try not to wash it for a while; my scalp was getting really itchy because of that but this has helped noticeably. My boyfriend also uses it for the scalp health and hair growth/thickening benefits. His hair is looking nicer and shinier overall! Smell is a bit strong, and lasts for a while post-wash, but it is a pleasant smell in my opinion.
reviews.zh: 我買呢款有兩個原因。我會拉直頭髮，又會一段時間唔洗頭；因為咁，頭皮痕到好嬲，但呢款明顯幫咗我。我男朋友都用呢款嚟護理頭皮同促進頭髮生長／令頭髮變粗。佢嘅頭髮整體睇落更好、更有光澤！味道有少少濃，洗完之後會留返一段時間，不過我覺得係好聞嘅味道。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: I was really hopeful for this product as I love Aromatica's root enhancer but I haven't been wow'd by this. It feels like a reasonable shampoo but it didn't have a cooling effect on my hair and I didn't think my hair felt particularly better after washing with it.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款產品好有期望，因為我好鍾意 Aromatica 嘅 root enhancer，但係呢款未令我特別驚喜。佢係一款幾好嘅洗頭水，不過冇令頭髮有清涼感，我都唔覺得洗完之後頭髮特別好咗。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: Đầu mình siêu dầu mà gội xcong tóc khô,da đầu ngứa quá trời.qua ngày hôm sau tưởng k gội cũng k sao mà tóc bết x2 bình thường :))) may mà mua luc có kupon giá còn hơn 1 sen tẹo nó đỡ tiếc.se trải nghiệm thêm vài lần xem có khác k,nếu k thì phải vứt rồi
reviews.zh: 我個頭好油，但係洗完頭髮都乾晒，頭皮痕到不得了。第二日以為唔洗都冇事，點知頭髮黏咗兩倍，同平時一樣 :))) 幸好買嗰陣有優惠券，價錢都仲有少少平，所以冇咁後悔。我會再試幾次睇有冇分別，如果冇，就要扔咗佢。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
